title: Cuttwood Bar Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cuttwood Nic Salt Pineapple Ice offers the sweet and tangy taste of ripe pineapples with a refreshing icy finish. This e-liquid captures the vibrant and juicy flavour of pineapple, complemented by a cool menthol undertone. Perfect for vapers who enjoy tropical fruit flavours with a refreshing twist. Cuttwood Nic Salt e-liquids are crafted with a balanced 50VG/50PG mix, making them perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping devices and pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, offering an effective alternative for adult smokers and vapers. Hailing from the USA, Cuttwood are renowned for their high-quality e-liquids and distinctive flavour profiles. Their dedication to excellence has earned them a loyal following among vapers worldwide. Now available in the UK, Cuttwood Nic Salts bring their premium flavours to a broader audience in the form of nicotine salt vape liquids, ideal for use with various MTL vape devices.
